title: Predictive learning: computer vision
reading: The slide applies predictive (self-supervised) learning to computer vision through masked image modeling, using the context encoder approach. The stated task is to predict masked image patches with ConvNets. It cites 'Context Encoders: Feature Learning by Inpainting, CVPR 2016' as the source work.

concepts.name: Masked image modeling
concepts.why_it_matters: Self-supervised pretext task where hidden image regions must be reconstructed, yielding transferable features.

concepts.name: Context encoder / inpainting
concepts.why_it_matters: Early ConvNet realization of masked prediction in vision.
